answer: A beacon admits work only inside a measured gale; pearl pays for that capacity and is lost on a missed signed check. The beacon folds heads whose timing, refunds or route proofs rhyme. One operator’s kth head must be born in the kth later gale, add k pearl while all earlier pearl stays locked, then pass that gale’s check. First head: 1 pearl, one gale. n clones cost 1+…+n pearl across n later gale events; fresh wallets merge.
